text:
ops-bot: Quick internal: soft-launching Dedicated H100X + L70Q in af-south-1 (cape-town-cpt-1) today. Limited canary, 72h staged rollout. New reservations paused for 14 days. :south_africa:

marta.prod: Short product note: L70Q is our quant-optimized L-series for long-context workloads; H100X targeted for low-p95 throughput. Early bench: L70Q shows ~19% token cost reduction vs A100X on 8k contexts with recommended quant profile. Will dump full charts later today.

jules-sre: Infra plan: starting footprint = 10 racks. Health gates: nvlink error rate <0.12%, kernel OOMs flat, and pod restart rate <0.5% over 2h. We'll apply a brief livepatch window 02:00-02:20 UTC (non-disruptive). Dashboards: infra/canary/cpt.

tomas.sales: Need embargoed blurb and temporary regional pricing for EMEA+AF. Also: can we allow a few strategic partners to reserve during canary?

marta.prod: Policy: strategic partners and existing Reserved customers can request early migration. New small reservations paused. Reservation exceptions via capacity form with "cpt-h100x-exception" tag. Link: https://redwood.company/capacity-request

anya-support: Support runbook update plan: tag customer tickets with "cpt-h100x". If customers report p95 regressions, collect model id, seq len, tokens/sample, and route. Escalate to #eng-runtime if nvlink or OOM traces are present. I'll pre-seed canned replies.

lee-ops: Rolling plan: (0-24h) internal + partner beta on 10 racks, (24-72h) expand to 40 racks if health OK, (72h+) open for wider Dedicated reservations. Rollback if any gating metric breaches.

jules-sre: Ops note: example canary test command for teams: ```bash
redwoodctl run --region af-south-1 --gpu L70Q --cpus 12 --image company/infer:canary --env MODEL=prod-large
```

tomas.sales: Pricing/billing note: L70Q will be L-series SKU. Intro regional uplift +9% for 21 days; exact SKUs and sample invoices will be posted to pricing repo by EOD.

marta.prod: Perf caveat: if you use custom quant configs outside our recommended profile, perf may vary more — include that in any customer comms.

ops-bot: Reservation exceptions only via the capacity form including customer id, expected QPS, and preferred start. Tag #capacity for urgent requests. Reactions: :rocket: :earth_africa:
